analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($109,293/$86,964) — Below SMA100, above SMA200, mixed mid-to-long term trend.

· RSI trajectory (41.0→43.0) + Neutral zone + Weak recovery.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1052.1167→-641.8717) + Improving diagnosis + Not yet a trend reversal signal.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Trading volume ratio (0.58x) + Low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + Entry condition: RSI recovers above 50 with accompanying volume, or breaks resistance.
